description: Presidential Secretariat - Notify that Mr. Sumith Abeysinghe has appointed to act in the Post of Secretary to the President, w.e.f. 02.06.2018
categorisation: This gazette exclusively announces a personnel appointment (Mr. Sumith Abeysinghe to act as Secretary to the President) and names the individual involved. It does not describe any detailed portfolio responsibilities, functions, or structural changes to the government, which aligns with the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
